pages.title: Alien Rocket : Cosmic Escape
pages.creator: FKDURRANI
pages.description: Pilot a rocket from Earth's atmosphere into deep space in Alien Rocket : Cosmic Escape. Steer around asteroids and UFOs, gather Stardust during missions, and stay in one piece when a boss appears.

pages.title: Chainline
pages.creator: Luminosity
pages.description: Slingshot your critter from peg to peg in Chainline. Use the momentum from each release to climb past saw blades, collect candy coins, and build up Hyper Fever by skimming close to hazards.

pages.title: Light Bulb Puzzle
pages.creator: codementors
pages.description: Turn on every light in Light Bulb Puzzle. Since tapping one bulb can change others, trace the connections on the board and work out which switches will leave them all glowing.

pages.title: Theme word search
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Pick a topic in Theme word search and scan the letter grid for the words on your list. Work through puzzles from different categories to practice spotting familiar terms and finding new ones.

pages.title: Farm Blast
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Blast groups of matching farm pieces in Farm Blast and focus on the objective for the current level. Work around obstacles, set up chain reactions, and use boosters when they help clear a difficult board.

pages.title: Animal Blocks
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Arrange animal blocks to form groups of at least three matching faces in Animal Blocks. Look for matches that open up space on the board and keep clearing groups to build a higher score.

pages.title: Merge Tower Hero
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Merge units to strengthen your team in Merge Tower Hero. Work out which combinations improve your chances in the next fight, then put your assembled team to the test against tougher opponents.

pages.title: Noob archer vs Stickman Zombie: zombie shooter
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Help Nubik stop the stickman zombies in Noob archer vs Stickman Zombie: zombie shooter. Aim your bow at the attackers and take out the enemies that show up after the quiet at home is interrupted.

pages.title: Ball Bunker: Sneaky Stacks
pages.creator: Carrot Quest
pages.description: Build a shelter around the ball in Ball Bunker: Sneaky Stacks. Rotate and drop pieces to close gaps, then release the attacking balls to see whether your structure protects the one inside.

pages.title: Prásino
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Travel through the forest in Prásino and gather magical seeds to plant new trees. Explore the landscape as you look for places to restore, and keep going as the forest comes back to life.

pages.title: Grill It All
pages.creator: Guangzhou Yomitoo Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Match identical skewers on the grills in Grill It All. Arrange ingredients such as fish, leeks and meatballs to complete orders, and use tool upgrades to help manage busier boards.

pages.title: 4 Colors Card Mania
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Play against computer opponents in 4 Colors Card Mania. Match a card by color or number, use special cards to change the pace of the round, and try to empty your hand first.

pages.title: Pin Puzzle Save The Sheep
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Decide which pins to pull in Pin Puzzle Save The Sheep. Get food to the sheep while keeping dangers away from them, and look at how the barriers separate everything before making your first move.

pages.title: Sandstorm Covert Ops
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Lead a covert operation in Sandstorm Covert Ops. Move through desert terrain to gather intelligence and strike enemy positions as you work to break up the organization controlling the region.

pages.title: Cashier Game
pages.creator: BOLD CAT
pages.description: Ring up groceries and give customers the right change in Cashier Game. Move bills between the trays to handle each payment, then spend your earnings on furnishings and other improvements for the store.

pages.title: Crime Theft Gangster Paradise
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Fight through the neon-lit streets of Las Vegas in Crime Theft Gangster Paradise. Use the weapons you have on hand in shootouts and look for loot as you move through the city.

pages.title: Cosmic Tetriz Puzzles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Fit colorful blocks into the target shape in Cosmic Tetriz Puzzles. Work out where each piece belongs on the grid as you assemble pixel pictures across 45 space-themed levels.

pages.title: Rescue Rift
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Take on a hostage rescue as an undercover operative in Rescue Rift. Think through your approach to each dangerous area and fight your way to the people your team has been sent to save.

pages.title: Block Color Puzzle Blast
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Drag blocks onto the grid in Block Color Puzzle Blast and fill complete lines to clear them. Leave room for the pieces still to come and try to complete multiple lines in one move for a combo.

pages.title: Crush it ALL!
pages.creator: Seryas Games
pages.description: Flip a bouncing anvil down the course in Crush it ALL! Squash objects such as fruit and bottles as you go, but time your jumps to clear fire and water on the way to the finish.

pages.title: Truck Simulator Offroad Driving
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Drive a loaded truck across uneven roads in Truck Simulator Offroad Driving. Adjust your speed to the ground ahead and keep the cargo aboard all the way to each delivery point.

pages.title: Word Mania
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Find and connect words in the stacked letters of Word Mania. Try different letter combinations, using what you've already found to help you work through the rest of each puzzle.

pages.title: Autumn Solitaire Tripeaks
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Clear cards from the tableau in Autumn Solitaire Tripeaks by taking cards one rank above or below the open card. Draw when you run out of moves, and choose classic play or one of 100 autumn layouts.

pages.title: Bubble Pirates Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Aim at the hanging bubbles in Bubble Pirates Mania and shoot into a group of the same color. Make matches of three or more to pop them and work your way through the board.

pages.title: Brick Game 3D
pages.creator: y9-games.com
pages.description: Move the paddle with the arrow keys in Brick Game 3D to keep the ball bouncing into the bricks. Pick up multiball bonuses to break through the remaining blocks faster.

pages.title: Rotate Bridge 3D
pages.creator: Ohayō
pages.description: Time the placement of spinning bridge sections in Rotate Bridge 3D. Build a route to the far side and extend it toward stranded characters when you can bring them along.

pages.title: Color Water Trucks
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Pull pins to direct the liquid in Color Water Trucks. Use colored liquid to dye the clear water, keep black liquid away, and make sure every truck receives the color it needs.

pages.title: Kick Color
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Knock incoming balls out of the air in Kick Color before they fall. Watch where the next ball is coming from and keep your shots timed as the pace picks up.

pages.title: Merry Christmas Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide tiles into place to rebuild holiday scenes in Merry Christmas Slide. Pick one of three pictures and try it on a 3-by-3 grid, or move up to a larger grid for a tougher puzzle.

pages.title: Arkadium's Klondike Solitaire
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Sort a deck into four suit piles in Arkadium's Klondike Solitaire. Build alternating-color sequences on the table to free hidden cards, and draw from the stock when the current layout runs out of moves.

pages.title: Old And New Cars Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Choose a drawing of a classic or modern car in Old And New Cars Coloring. Select colors and fill in the bodywork and smaller details to give each vehicle its own paint scheme.

pages.title: Cute Dinosaurs Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Color one of eight dinosaur pictures in Cute Dinosaurs Coloring. Choose from 23 colors, work quickly if you're aiming for a high score, and save the picture when you're happy with it.

pages.title: Animal Simulator Truck Transport 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Carry farm animals and wildlife in Animal Simulator Truck Transport 2020. Load the truck's animal carrier and steer the heavy vehicle carefully as you take each group to its destination.

pages.title: Magic Wood Lumberjack
pages.creator: PulseNova
pages.description: Cut down trees in Magic Wood Lumberjack and sell the wood to upgrade your equipment. Head farther into the forest for more valuable trees and watch for golden ones that contain bonuses.

pages.title: HexDomin.io
pages.creator: QiGames Studio
pages.description: Build a kingdom in HexDomin.io by lining up tiles that share a terrain type. Make the most of each placement over nine turns and aim to finish with the most valuable territory of four players.

pages.title: Jungle Balloons Addition
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Drop each numbered balloon onto the addition problem that gives its value in Jungle Balloons Addition. Correct matches build your score, while mistakes set you back on the way to the level target.

pages.title: Corona Crush Saga
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Line up groups of at least three identical viruses in Corona Crush Saga. Look for matches you can make quickly to clear more pieces and raise your score before the timer ends.

pages.title: Draw Tattoo
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Guide the tattoo needle over the design in Draw Tattoo. Work carefully around the edges and fill in the shape a little at a time as the artwork takes form.

pages.title: Arbor Day Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Piece together tree-themed pictures in Arbor Day Puzzle. Pick from six images and set the number of pieces anywhere from 16 to 100 to adjust how much detail you have to sort through.

pages.title: FindAnimalIO
pages.creator: RB Games
pages.description: Scan the picture for a hidden animal in FindAnimalIO. Look carefully at the shapes and colors in the scene, then click where you think the animal is hiding.

pages.title: Kawasaki Ninja 650 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of an anime character and a Kawasaki motorcycle in Kawasaki Ninja 650 Puzzle. Choose one of six images and play with 16, 36, 64 or 100 jigsaw pieces.

pages.title: Neon jump
pages.creator: jogosonlineapps.com.br
pages.description: Keep a neon ball jumping from platform to platform in Neon jump. Time your movements to make the next landing and see how many points you can collect in one run.

pages.title: Fastlaners
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Drive and shoot your way through street traffic in Fastlaners. Clear road hazards, take on wanted targets, and put the money you collect toward new vehicles or more powerful weapons.

pages.title: Mine Coin Adventure 2
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Cut ropes and rotate platforms in Mine Coin Adventure 2 to get a coin into the marked area. Plan its fall around spikes and pick up extra coins along the route.

pages.title: Pipe Master
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Turn pipe sections until water can flow from the inlet to the outlet in Pipe Master. Check the joints before you commit and make the connection within the moves available on each board.

pages.title: Food Stand Difference
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Compare the two food stand pictures in Food Stand Difference. Look closely at the characters and their surroundings, then select the small details that appear differently in the two scenes.

pages.title: Find Pairs. Toy Room
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Match pictures of toys in Find Pairs. Toy Room. Pay attention to what each picture shows and use your memory of the layout to find its partner among the others.

pages.title: Word Find Plus
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Select a category in Word Find Plus and trace words across the letter grid. Work through hundreds of puzzles and spend one of your hint points when a word stays hidden.

pages.title: Basket Cannon
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Fire a basketball from a cannon in Basket Cannon. Choose when to shoot so the ball reaches the hoop, and make the most of the shots you have as the setup changes.

pages.title: Land Rover Defender 110 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble jigsaws featuring the Land Rover Defender 110. Start with one of six vehicle pictures and choose from four piece counts, from a compact 16-piece board to a 100-piece puzzle.

pages.title: Monster Merge
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Bring three or more matching creatures together in Monster Merge to make a new monster. Plan around the result of each group so you can keep combining creatures as the board changes.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Bed Time
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Baby Hazel finish her bedtime routine in Baby Hazel Bed Time. Get her teeth brushed and her shower done, then make the bed and help her settle in for the night.

pages.title: Path Finding Cakes Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Move pastries through empty spaces in Path Finding Cakes Match to line up three identical cakes in a row or column. Find open routes and try to clear matches with fewer moves for a higher score.

pages.title: Battle Disc
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Throw a disc across the arena to break the other player's blocks in Battle Disc. Watch for a catch and be ready to intercept the return throw before it hits your own defenses.

pages.title: Luxury Sedan Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Choose a car picture in Luxury Sedan Puzzle and put it back together. Each of the six images can be played with 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces.

pages.title: Alien invasion
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Defend your territory from UFOs and falling bombs in Alien invasion. Move and fire your tank to survive as long as possible, and pick up supply boxes when they come within reach.

pages.title: Legend Street Fighter
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Use punches, kicks and jumping attacks to fight through Legend Street Fighter. Move into range to start a combo, then adjust your timing when the next opponent comes at you.

pages.title: EG Cowboy Run
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Run through the frontier in EG Cowboy Run and shoot monsters that block the way. Collect coins, extra lives and ammunition as you try to get farther than your previous run.

pages.title: Dragon Trials
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Guide a dragon through a series of flying challenges in Dragon Trials. Control it in the air, work through the levels and see what other dragons you can get as you progress.

pages.title: 2048 Puzzle
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Slide the numbered tiles in 2048 Puzzle and combine equal values to make bigger ones. Leave yourself space for the next move and see whether you can build a 2048 tile.

pages.title: Dangerous Rescue
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Fly a helicopter into mountainous terrain in Dangerous Rescue. Steer carefully around the slopes to reach people who need help, then get them out without crashing into the rock.

pages.title: Maths Challenge
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Solve timed arithmetic problems in Maths Challenge. Pick the answer that fits each question and keep working quickly to build a higher score as more problems come up.

pages.title: Guess the Name Hangman
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Guess a hidden name one letter at a time in Guess the Name Hangman. Use the letters already revealed to narrow down your choices before wrong guesses complete the hangman drawing.

pages.title: GT Bike Simulator
pages.creator: Virtua Games
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle through city stunt courses in GT Bike Simulator. Carry enough speed for jumps around the buildings and try different tricks as you work through the levels.

pages.title: Bag Design Fashion Week
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create handbags for a competition in Bag Design Fashion Week. Pick the colors, shapes and patterns for your designs, then send the finished bags to the jury to be judged.

pages.title: Sportbike Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Choose a motorcycle in Sportbike Simulator and take it out for a ride. Spend time getting a feel for the controls or look for places where you can try stunts at speed.

pages.title: Smiley IO
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Guide a smiling snake around the arena in Smiley IO. Gather energy to grow stronger and pay attention to the paths of other snakes as you move around the map.

pages.title: Stickman Archer Castle
pages.creator: Bubito
pages.description: Defend the castle in Stickman Archer Castle by firing arrows at incoming blocks. Aim at threats before they reach the wall and adjust your shots as more targets appear.

pages.title: Princesses Graduation Party Night
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Get the princesses ready to celebrate graduation in Princesses Graduation Party Night. Put together evening looks with dresses, heels and jewelry, and help organize the party for their big night.

pages.title: Wolf Simulator Wild Animals 3D
pages.creator: CyberGoldfinch
pages.description: Live as a wolf in Wolf Simulator Wild Animals 3D. Explore the surrounding territory, hunt animals and care for your wolf family as you take on the needs of life in the wild.

pages.title: Winter Snow Fairy Day
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Get a fairy ready to fly through the winter forest in Winter Snow Fairy Day. Choose her makeup and dress her in a winter outfit with a pair of matching wings.

pages.title: Mabel Dress Up Game
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Put together a new look for Gravity Falls' Mabel Pines in Mabel Dress Up Game. Try different pieces from her wardrobe and decide which combination suits her for a summer adventure.

pages.title: Pixel Gold Clicker
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Click for gold in Pixel Gold Clicker and put your earnings back into upgrades. Deal with the butterflies when they appear and see how much gold you can accumulate as you improve your setup.

pages.title: Hop Hop Ball!
pages.creator: Freelance
pages.description: Guide a hopping ball across platforms in Hop Hop Ball! Watch where the next landing is and keep the ball moving to see how high a score you can reach.

pages.title: Barbara and Friends Fairy Party
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Help two fairies get ready to celebrate in Barbara and Friends Fairy Party. Browse outfits for each friend and pair each finished look with wings that match the style you chose.

pages.title: Famous Dress Designer
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Design three wedding dresses for a competition in Famous Dress Designer. Help Annie develop a different look for each dress and present the finished collection to the judges at the end of the day.

pages.title: Street Race Pursuit
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Stay ahead of the police in Street Race Pursuit. Grab cash and power-ups as you drive, then use the space you gain to keep the chase going a little longer.

pages.title: Crescent Solitaire
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Move cards from the crescent into eight center foundations in Crescent Solitaire. Look for plays on the exposed cards and build the central piles until the outer cards are cleared.

pages.title: 1 vs 1 Soccer
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Take on a single opponent in 1 vs 1 Soccer. Move into position to reach the ball, defend your own goal when your rival has it, and look for openings to score.

pages.title: Zombie Night
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Aim at approaching zombies in Zombie Night and take them down before they reach you. Use the money you earn to improve your weapons so you can survive longer against the next group.

pages.title: Salad Bar
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Put together salads for hungry customers in Salad Bar. Check each order, choose the ingredients for the requested recipe, and keep working through the orders as they come in.
